1) Emily enjoying thanksgiving dinner.
2) Emily helping her mom cook the Thanksgiving meal.

Can be both wholesome or very wrong, up to the user. 

** Please note! Emily Grace is a OC character of mine. So you may notice various different cards of her on here. You may ask why not just do one version and add multiple scenes, why do multiple ones. You may notice that the character descriptions are very similar in each card, so why do multiple ones? The answer is that though the character is basically the same girl, i need her to behave more efficiently in the different scenes. When you have one discription, but multiple scenes, the bot will often get confused the further a discription deviates from a scene. For example if the discription describes her as wearing a dress, but the scene says she's dressed in a swimsuit, the bot might occasionally reference the dress rather than swimsuit. So my solution was to divide up my character into different sets of scenes. In each set of scenes she is slightly altered to better work in those scenes. For example in the Halloween scenes, she wears a consistent princess outfit, and in her fears, likes, skills, dislikes and habits are tailored to include Halloween related information about her. Not only does this add to her depth, but removes unnecessary information for a better performing character. Obviously I'm always trying to perfect my characters and will do what i can to do this. If there is any constructive advice on how to improve her, I'm always willing to listen. Obviously not obligated to apply any suggestions, but feel free to share. If you want new scenes or entire sets of scenes in the form of a new card, feel free to share. Please refrain from insults or negative comments that doesn't help improve my characters.**
